data.narrative:
Chai Discovery, a Series C biotech firm founded by Joshua Meier (former Chief AI Officer at Absci, Meta/FAIR protein language modeling researcher) and Jack Dent (ex-Stripe), carries a current post-money valuation of $3.8B on $400M raised. The valuation assessment draws from a comparables universe of 3 public biotech equities (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), New Limit ($3.1B Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M Series B).

Two valuation methods triangulate the fair value range. The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $6.5B. The Peer-Median method across same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables anchors to $3.1B, with the broader peer set ranging $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via sector P/S median (6.6x across 3 tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure. The two applicable methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $2.6B (low) to $7.4B (high), with a median of $4.8B.

The analysis supports a fair-value band centered near $4.8B, roughly 26% above the current $3.8B post-money. Key uncertainties include the target's unreported revenue trajectory, clinical or commercialization milestones undisclosed in the dataset, and the wide dispersion within the peer set ($539M to $10.3B), reflecting heterogeneous stage and technology risk profiles within biotech.
